docs.summary: Core manager for the sf-pi package on OMP. Provides /sf-pi list/enable/disable/status/display/recommended/announcements/skills/doctor/auto-update commands plus the interactive TUI overlay and settings panel. The OMP runtime is the native omp on PATH and stays with omp update. Opt-in Auto Update waits for a non-aborted terminal agent_end (settled turn), fast-forwards the sf-omp git checkout (git pull --ff-only + npm ci, only when cleanly behind its upstream), and runs the independent Salesforce CLI stable update. /sf-pi recommended reports recommended packages as unsupported because the launcher loads extensions explicit-only. alwaysActive: enable/disable is mediated through this extension only; it is stored as native disabledExtensions in OMP YAML config and applies on the next OMP start.
safety: Owns the WRITE side of OMP's disabledExtensions for bundled extensions via lib/common/omp-extension-state.ts.
Auto Update is opt-in, interactive-session only, deferred after aborted settlements, machine-locked, abortable, and output-redacted; it never updates the OMP runtime.

Checkout automation only fast-forwards a clean, attached branch strictly behind its upstream; dirty, detached, ahead, diverged, and upstream-less checkouts are left untouched, and no package or plugin installer runs.
alwaysActive cannot be disabled through the standard toggle action.
